newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil premiums fall.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil premiums fall.

text.p: NWE gas oil and fuel oil declined with crude on Wednesday, but light ends were steady.
Gasoline was steady despite a sharp fall in NYMEX futures, partly because trade died towards the close and European supply was tight, particularly for high octane grades.
Naphtha edged sideways despite weaker crude oil.
Gas oil fell with futures, but premiums slipped too on the prospect of increased supply from the Mediterranean and the United States.
Fuel oil slightly weaker with crude and demand thin.
